displayName.description: Present only on operations that explicitly need it for human display (e.g. CRM). Omitted from every balance/posting-adjacent payload.

ssnLast4.description: Masked — last 4 digits only. The full SSN is accepted on write (FindOrCreatePartyRequest) but is NEVER echoed back in any response, at any field, under any circumstance — defense in depth beyond field-level encryption at rest: even a fully authorized, correctly-scoped caller only ever sees the mask.

tombstoned.description: Party records are never deleted (7-year audit retention). true once soft-deleted; the record and its full history remain queryable.

version.description: 1 for the first document of this documentType on this party; incremented on each replacement. Immutable and versioned like TermVersion elsewhere in this system — a replacement never edits or deletes a prior version.

supersedesDocumentId.description: The documentId this version replaces, if any. Null for version 1.

documentNumberLast4.description: Masked, same defense-in-depth principle as Party.ssnLast4 — the full document number is accepted on write and encrypted at rest, never echoed back.

matched.description: true if this find-or-create call resolved to an EXISTING party rather than creating a new one.

confidence.description: Deterministic, rule-derived score — never an ML/probabilistic model output. See the dedup engine's named rule table for exactly how each value is produced.

matchedFields.description: Which input fields corroborated the match, e.g. ["ssn", "dateOfBirth"] — field NAMES only, never the field VALUES (avoids leaking PII into an audit/explanation payload).

ruleId.description: The specific named dedup rule that fired, e.g. SSN_EXACT, NAME_DOB_EXACT, EMAIL_NAME_CORROBORATED — makes every decision traceable to one auditable rule, not a black box.
